hook.text: In China, Google doesn't exist. Neither do Facebook, Twitter, or YouTube. One billion people use a different internet.

buildup.text: The Great Firewall blocks foreign platforms and keywords. Domestic alternatives like WeChat and Weibo are monitored.

discovery.text: The system works not by blocking everything but by making access slow and inconvenient. Friction beats censorship.

twist.text: Many Chinese citizens can use VPNs to bypass the firewall. Most choose not to. Domestic apps are simply better.

climax.text: China proved that a controlled internet can coexist with economic growth. The Western assumption was wrong.

punchline.text: The wall works because most people don't climb it.

quiz.question: Why does China's Great Firewall succeed despite VPN availability?
options: Citizens face prison for using VPNs
